Quick summary: Obsidian VaultWorks is a European fintech (card issuing + transaction analytics) evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for low-latency reranking and embeddings-based fraud detection. They have strict EU data residency needs and require customer-managed KMS + audit logs forwarded into their SIEM.

Key quotes from kickoff: "We cannot send raw transaction data outside EU regions; keys must be customer-controlled." — Head of InfoSec.

Deployment constraints / must-haves (shorthand):
- VPC-only: no public managed endpoints unless through approved peering or NAT.
- Customer KMS (AWS KMS + HSM) required; Redwood must support Encrypt/Decrypt using CMK via IAM role trust.
- Audit trail: token-level and request metadata (requester, model, route, token count, timestamps) forwarded to Splunk/Syslog in real time.
- Data retention policy: 30 days max for logs; models cannot persist PII per contract. Ability to disable training/analytics toggles.
- Resiliency: regional failover within EU (eu-west-1, eu-central-1) with deterministic routing and canary fallback to smaller open-model replicas.

Technical specifics they asked about on the call:
- VPC topology: private subnets for inference nodes, public bastion in ops subnet for SSH jump (if allowed), NAT for outbound to Redwood control plane endpoints. Need diagram showing route tables, NAT gateways, and VPC endpoints.
- Inbound/outbound: inbound only from whitelisted app load balancer (ALB) IPs or peered VPC CIDR; no internet-facing ingress. Outbound must be constrained to Redwood control plane IP ranges + KMS endpoints, with egress via NAT or VPC endpoint.
- Peering / Transit: prefer VPC peering or AWS Transit Gateway for low latency; VPN as fallback during POC.
- KMS integration: customer will create CMKs and grant Redwood cross-account decrypt/encrypt role. Need sample IAM trust policy and key policy to pass their internal review.
- Audit logging: prefer push to customer SIEM via secure syslog over private link or S3 bucket notifications with SSE-C/KMS. Need to support both.

POC scope / metrics:
- Workloads: reranking 120–200 QPS, embeddings batch jobs (offline) 10k vectors/day, real-time support-agent queries 20–40 TPS.
- Latency target: P95 < 250ms for reranking, P99 < 500ms.
- Throughput target: sustained 150 req/s during peak hours.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high; will request Optimize recommendations for quantization + batching to hit TCO targets.
